summary: Picnic is dutch online supermarket, founded in 2015. Type: private company. About 5,569 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 32 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 9 about growth or hiring.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06
LinkedIn page (existing data, collected via Apify; LinkedIn terms forbid scraping)

culture.text: Says it has no strict structures and expects you to take ownership from day one.
Staff often come from UvA, TU Delft, Hogeschool Utrecht, HvA and VU, mostly in economics, business, logistics or computer science.
Builds almost everything itself, from forecasting and automated warehouses to electric vehicles and its own software.

open.text: Picnic International B.V. and Picnic Technologies B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Says it has over 85 nationalities on the team.

growth.text: Started in 2015 and now delivers groceries to millions across the Netherlands, Germany and France.
Hired Amazon manager Eva Faict, starting in December.

worth_knowing.text: Faced bad press after one of its delivery drivers splashed a cyclist, and moved to clear the air.
